title: BSC wallet source inventory
objective: Inventory only authorized local BSC sources after BSC-OFFLINE-RESEARCH-STAGE-ACTIVATION-001-AUDIT-001 is GREEN and the Owner merge-commits the separately scoped activation implementation. This task has no Solana E2E dependency and is limited to offline-local research: establish source schemas, period credibility, EOA/contract uncertainty, replay feasibility, accounting risks, and minimum acquisition gaps without network collection. It remains BLOCKED_STAGE until the governing stage configuration is activated by that audited, Owner-merged activation.
forbidden_actions: Do not execute real trades, sign transactions, broadcast transactions, or connect a trading wallet.
Do not read seed phrases, private keys, browser cookies, login sessions, DPAPI material, or trading API keys.
Do not automate a logged-in GMGN page; only consume user-provided offline exports from the private root.
Do not commit wallet addresses, transaction hashes, raw GMGN exports, chainfm_out contents, or private manifests containing raw records.
Do not treat null, unknown, or missing values as zero.
Do not create a cross-chain global wallet score or assume SOL and BSC addresses identify the same entity.
Do not squash, rebase, rewrite pushed history, push to main, or merge a PR.
Do not fetch BSC data from the network or hardcode contract addresses from memory.
If BSC data is insufficient, produce a precise PARK acquisition plan; do not fabricate a master wallet database.
Do not activate BSC Live capability, any Live provider, resident listener, automated GMGN workflow, or production database write.
Do not treat Solana E2E completion as a dependency or gate for this BSC offline-local-research task.
